candidates: [TECH] When assessing image quality, do not reward high contrast or stylized grain if it obscures fine details or introduces artifacts; instead, prioritize preservation of texture and edge clarity.

[CONTENT] When content is culturally or historically significant (e.g., ancient carvings, architecture), prioritize legibility and structural integrity over artistic interpretation.
[NATURAL] If an image appears overly processed or synthetic (e.g., excessive sharpening, unnatural lighting), downweight its score even if it is visually engaging.
[GLOBAL] Always compare the image to a neutral baseline of photographic realism before applying any stylistic or artistic weighting.
